title: Changing only Last Name does not alter First Name
preconditions: Logged in as a seeded user with known firstName/lastName
steps: On /profile, change only Last Name and click 'Save Changes'
expectedResult: First Name remains exactly as it was before the save — no cross-field corruption from the partial update.

title: Notification switches toggle immediately in the UI before Save is pressed
steps: On /profile, click the 'System Updates' switch without clicking 'Save Changes'
expectedResult: The switch visually flips state immediately (client-side state only) — this local toggle works correctly regardless of the known server-side persistence gap (PROF-INT-002).

title: 'My Projects' lists the caller's own project memberships with the correct role badge
description: Sourced from GET /users/me/projects (exports.getMyProjects) — project.admin bypass users see every active org project with permissions:[], while regular members see only their ProjectMember rows with a resolved projectRoleName/isProjectRoleAdmin badge.
preconditions: Logged in as a non-admin user who is a member of exactly one project with a named project role
steps: Open /profile and view the 'My Projects' card
expectedResult: Exactly one project row is shown, with a badge showing the project role name (not 'Project Admin') matching what GET /users/me/projects returns for projectRoleName/isProjectRoleAdmin.

title: 'View Activity Log' button in Account Activity has no click handler and performs no action
description: profile/page.jsx renders the 'View Activity Log' Button with no onClick prop — clicking it is currently a dead control with no navigation, modal, or API call.
steps: On /profile, click 'View Activity Log' under Account Activity
expectedResult: Current behavior: nothing happens — no navigation, no drawer/modal opens, no network request fires. Flagged as an incomplete/placeholder control for follow-up rather than a functioning feature.
